concepts.gloss_en: Long-suffering / divine forbearance (patience); the opposite of fierce anger, attained through faith and tied to the Land of Israel

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are in the same lesson (LM 155) and denote the identical concept of erekh/arikhat apayim (patience), explicitly contrasted with charon af and linked to faith. The only difference is the ל- prefix on לאריכת אפים, which is a prepositional inflection of the same noun phrase, not a homograph. Same word, same meaning — safe merge.
